notes:
Added
- Agents report each purchase over MCP the moment they pay (Claude Desktop, Claude Code,
  Cursor, Windsurf); agent-ledger setup connects them.
- Email receipts and a bank feed (SimpleFIN or CSV) verify agent reports. A charge seen
  more than once counts once and gets a ✓.
- Home screen: the month's total, % verified, pace for the month, one line per agent.
- Per-agent monthly budgets, with warnings at 80% and 100%, readable by agents
  (get_budget).
- An inbox that guesses which agent bought a charge, with a reason, and confirms the sure
  ones in one tap. Keyboard shortcuts.
- Search with running totals; "Subscriptions agents started".
- Export to CSV, YNAB and Lunch Money.
- First-run setup checklist, a "What's stored" page, and an install guide for
  non-developers.
- A beta download (scripts/package-beta.sh) with a double-click launcher.
